full_page.content:
Pg. 20. Handwritten notes -"Retreat Nov. 25 - 65th birthday (as cele- brated by dear ones at Home) -Benedcamus Domino Deo Gratias!
Monday 25, 1935 - Conference - Personal Responsability - why did God prefer me - for creation - to be a Capuchin?
Obedience - naturally hard - against grain of tainted nature- Conference.
Conference - B1. Poverty - How possible when nothing necessary is wanting? Simply by asking for permission to use whatever may be given us - Extra: by contenting ourselves with what we get.
Tuesday 26
I. Chastity - supernatural virtue - angelic - contrary to this virtue - impurity, indulgence in "sex-passion" ..... as such not bad in itself
Temptations of this nature, not sinful but dangerous. Remedy? Prayer to the Immaculata and -"Beat it". Think of something else.
II. "I strictly forbid suspicious intercourse with"wowen". Suspect and examine into desire for seeing "Mrs. or Miss So an So".
III. Gentleness .. "I beseech you brethren ... neither Quarrel nor dispute nor judge others. but be meek ..... speaking courte- ously to everyone as is becoming".
Wed. Nov. 27
I. Worldliness (tame)
II. Curiosity .... "Quid ad te? Attende tibi." ... "Me Tu sequer" ...
III. "Pax Huic Domui" ... Love your brother for God's sake - because he is God's
Thurs. Nov. 28, 1935
I. Honest Work ... Only the Best possible should I offer to God.
II. Devotion to the Holy Ghost. "I beseech You The Spirit of the Lord & His ..... Deo Gratias Veni Sancte Spiritu
III. Mary ... Mother of God ... Gate of Heaven.
